title: Brahmins urge Vasishta to select a youth to be the king
introduction: That night in Ayodhya passed over with agony. At sunrise the Brahmins who enthrone a person as a king, assembled and requested Vasista the family priest of Ikshvakus to select a youth to be crowned as a king of Ayodhya. They enunciated the various evil consequences of allowing the country without a king and leaving it in anarchy.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तषष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 67th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
आक्रन्दितनिरानन्दा सास्रकम्ठजनाविला |
आयोध्यायामतितता सा व्यतीयाय शर्वरी
verses.iast:
ākranditanirānandā sāsrakamṭhajanāvilā |
āyodhyāyāmatitatā sā vyatīyāya śarvarī
verses.translation: That night in Ayodhya, which was joyless in a weeping tone and thronged with people with tears in their throats, slowly passed over.

glosses.meaning: which was joyless with a weeping tone
thronged with people with tears in their throats

verses.devanagari:
व्यतीतायाम् तु शर्वर्याम् आदित्यस्य उदये ततः |
समेत्य राज कर्तारः सभाम् ईयुर् द्विजातयः
verses.iast:
vyatītāyām tu śarvaryām ādityasya udaye tataḥ |
sametya rāja kartāraḥ sabhām īyur dvijātayaḥ
verses.translation: At sunrise, when the night had passed over, the Brahmins who place a king on the throne, together gathered at the assembly.

glosses.meaning: when the night. Vyatiitaayaam = was passing away
who place a king on the throne

verses.devanagari:
मार्कण्डेयो अथ मौद्गल्यो वामदेवः च काश्यपः |
कात्ययनो गौतमः च जाबालिः च महा यशाः
एते द्विजाः सह अमात्यैः पृथग् वाचम् उदीरयन् |
वसिष्ठम् एव अभिमुखाः श्रेष्ठः राज पुरोहितम्
verses.iast:
mārkaṇḍeyo atha maudgalyo vāmadevaḥ ca kāśyapaḥ |
kātyayano gautamaḥ ca jābāliḥ ca mahā yaśāḥ
ete dvijāḥ saha amātyaiḥ pṛthag vācam udīrayan |
vasiṣṭham eva abhimukhāḥ śreṣṭhaḥ rāja purohitam
verses.translation: Markandeya, Moudgalya, Vamadeva, Kasyapa,Katyayana, Goutama and the greatly famous Jabali-all these Brahmans together with the ministers turned towards the excellent royal priest Vasishta and one by one spoke as follows:

verses.devanagari:
अतीता शर्वरी दुह्खम् या नो वर्ष शत उपमा |
अस्मिन् पन्चत्वम् आपन्ने पुत्र शोकेन पार्थिवे
verses.iast:
atītā śarvarī duhkham yā no varṣa śata upamā |
asmin pancatvam āpanne putra śokena pārthive
verses.translation: "King Dasaratha having obtained death due to grief born of separation from his sons (Rama and Lakshmana), the night which burdened like a hundred years, has passed over with great difficulty."

glosses.meaning: due to grief for his sons
which was equal to a hundred years

verses.devanagari:
स्वर् गतः च महा राजो रामः च अरण्यम् आश्रितः |
लक्ष्मणः च अपि तेजस्वी रामेण एव गतः सह
verses.iast:
svar gataḥ ca mahā rājo rāmaḥ ca araṇyam āśritaḥ |
lakṣmaṇaḥ ca api tejasvī rāmeṇa eva gataḥ saha
verses.translation: "The monarch has gone to heaven. Rama took retreat in a forest. The brilliant Lakshmana followed suit and went along with Rama."

glosses.meaning: in a forest. tejasvii = The brilliant
along with Rama in the same manner."

verses.devanagari:
उभौ भरत शत्रुघ्नौ क्केकयेषु परम् तपौ |
पुरे राज गृहे रम्ये मातामह निवेशने
verses.iast:
ubhau bharata śatrughnau kkekayeṣu param tapau |
pure rāja gṛhe ramye mātāmaha niveśane
verses.translation: "Both Bharata and Satrughna, the annihilator of enemies, are encamped in the beautiful house of their maternal uncle in the city of Rajagriha in the kingdom of Kekaya."

glosses.meaning: are encamped in the beautiful house of their maternal uncle

verses.devanagari:
इक्ष्वाकूणाम् इह अद्य एव कश्चित् राजा विधीयताम् |
अराजकम् हि नो राष्ट्रम् न विनाशम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.iast:
ikṣvākūṇām iha adya eva kaścit rājā vidhīyatām |
arājakam hi no rāṣṭram na vināśam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: "Hence, let anyone here in Ikshvaku dynasty be made a king today itself lest our nation without a king should result in a collapse indeed."

verses.devanagari:
न अराजले जन पदे विद्युन् माली महा स्वनः |
अभिवर्षति पर्जन्यो महीम् दिव्येन वारिणा
verses.iast:
na arājale jana pade vidyun mālī mahā svanaḥ |
abhivarṣati parjanyo mahīm divyena vāriṇā
verses.translation: "Lightning clouds in the sky with a great noise of thunder, will not yield rain on the land in a country without a king."

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जन पदे बीज मुष्टिः प्रकीर्यते |
न अराकके पितुः पुत्रः भार्या वा वर्तते वशे
verses.iast:
na arājake jana pade bīja muṣṭiḥ prakīryate |
na arākake pituḥ putraḥ bhāryā vā vartate vaśe
verses.translation: "Even a fist of seeds are not disbursed in a ruler- less land. In anarchy, even a son is not amenable to the control of a father nor a wife in the authority of her husband."

verses.devanagari:
अराजके धनम् न अस्ति न अस्ति भार्या अपि अराजके |
इदम् अत्याहितम् च अन्यत् कुतः सत्यम् अराजके
verses.iast:
arājake dhanam na asti na asti bhāryā api arājake |
idam atyāhitam ca anyat kutaḥ satyam arājake
verses.translation: "In a rulerless land, there is no wealth. Where there is no king, there is no (faithful) wife. Another very dangerous thing is there. In a ruler less territory, how can there be truth? "

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जन पदे कारयन्ति सभाम् नराः |
उद्यानानि च रम्याणि हृष्टाः पुण्य गृहाणि च
verses.iast:
na arājake jana pade kārayanti sabhām narāḥ |
udyānāni ca ramyāṇi hṛṣṭāḥ puṇya gṛhāṇi ca
verses.translation: "In a ruler- less country, people do not cause to make a delightful assembly nor erect beautiful parks or temples."

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जन पदे यज्ञ शीला द्विजातयः |
सत्राणि अन्वासते दान्ता ब्राह्मणाः संशित व्रताः
verses.iast:
na arājake jana pade yaGYa śīlā dvijātayaḥ |
satrāṇi anvāsate dāntā brāhmaṇāḥ saṃśita vratāḥ
verses.translation: "In a ruler- less territory, those who frequently perform sacrificial rites, those who have self-restraint, those who firmly adhere to a vow as well as Brahmins do not carry out Soma sacrifices."

glosses.meaning: Those who frequently perform sacrificial rites
those who firmly adhere to a vow

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जनपदे महायज्ञेषु यज्वनः |
ब्राह्मणा वसुसम्पन्ना विसृजन्त्याप्तदक्षिणाः
verses.iast:
na arājake janapade mahāyajJṇeṣu yajvanaḥ |
brāhmaṇā vasusampannā visṛjantyāptadakśiṇāḥ
verses.translation: "In a rulerless land, Brahmans who obtained wealth and sacrificers in great sacrificial rites do not bestow proper gifts"

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जन पदे प्रभूत नट नर्तकाः |
उत्सवाः च समाजाः च वर्धन्ते राष्ट्र वर्धनाः
verses.iast:
na arājake jana pade prabhūta naṭa nartakāḥ |
utsavāḥ ca samājāḥ ca vardhante rāṣṭra vardhanāḥ
verses.translation: "In a ruler- less territory, festivals and gatherings exalting the kingdom in which actors, and dancers exhibit their talents are not frequently arranged"

verses.devanagari:
न अरजके जन पदे सिद्ध अर्था व्यवहारिणः |
कथाभिर् अनुरज्यन्ते कथा शीलाः कथा प्रियैः
verses.iast:
na arajake jana pade siddha arthā vyavahāriṇaḥ |
kathābhir anurajyante kathā śīlāḥ kathā priyaiḥ
verses.translation: "In a ruler less land, litigants do not get their disputes settled and persons who have a knack for narrating stories do not gratify story- lovers with their tales."

glosses.meaning: do not get their disputes settled
and those who frequently narrate stories

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जनपदे उद्यानानि समागताः |
सायाह्ने क्रीडितुम् यान्ति कुमार्यो हेमभूषिताः
verses.iast:
na arājake janapade udyānāni samāgatāḥ |
sāyāhne krīḍitum yānti kumāryo hemabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: "In a ruler less territory, girls adorned in gold do not go together to parks to play there in the evening."

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जन पदे वाहनैः शीघ्र गामिभिः |
नरा निर्यान्ति अरण्यानि नारीभिः सह कामिनः
verses.iast:
na arājake jana pade vāhanaiḥ śīghra gāmibhiḥ |
narā niryānti araṇyāni nārībhiḥ saha kāminaḥ
verses.translation: "In a lord less land, lustful men do not go out to woods with ladies in speedily moving vehicles"

verses.devanagari:
न अराकजे जन पदे धनवन्तः सुरक्षिताः |
शेरते विवृत द्वाराः कृषि गो रक्ष जीविनः
verses.iast:
na arākaje jana pade dhanavantaḥ surakṣitāḥ |
śerate vivṛta dvārāḥ kṛṣi go rakṣa jīvinaḥ
verses.translation: "In a lord less land, rich people living on agriculture and cattle rearing do not sleep in their abodes well protected, with their doors open"

glosses.meaning: living on agriculture and cattle rearing

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जनपदे बद्दघण्टा विषाणीनः |
आटन्ति राजमार्गेषु कुञ्जराः षष्टिहायनाः
verses.iast:
na arājake janapade baddaghaṇṭā viṣāṇInaḥ |
āṭanti rājamārgeṣu kuJṇjarāḥ ṣaṣṭihāyanāḥ
verses.translation: "In a land without emperor, sixty year old elephants with bells tied around their tusks, do not roam around on royal high ways

glosses.meaning: with bells tied around their tusks

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जनपदे शरान् सम्ततमस्यताम् |
श्रूयते तलनिर्घोष इष्वस्त्राणामुपासने
verses.iast:
na arājake janapade śarān samtatamasyatām |
śrūyate talanirghoṣa iṣvastrāṇāmupāsane
verses.translation: "In a ruler less land, the noise of plucking the bow string with the palm, produced by archers continuously discharging arrows while practicing the use of their bows, is not heard."

glosses.meaning: the noise of plucking the bow string with the palm

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जन पदे वणिजो दूर गामिनः |
गच्चन्ति क्षेमम् अध्वानम् बहु पुण्य समाचिताः
verses.iast:
na arājake jana pade vaṇijo dūra gāminaḥ |
gaccanti kṣemam adhvānam bahu puṇya samācitāḥ
verses.translation: "In a rulerless land, traders who go to distant places, carrying with them several merchandises, cannot travel safely in their voyages."

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जन पदे चरति एक चरः वशी |
भावयन्न् आत्मना आत्मानम् यत्र सायम् गृहो मुनिः
verses.iast:
na arājake jana pade carati eka caraḥ vaśī |
bhāvayann ātmanā ātmānam yatra sāyam gṛho muniḥ
verses.translation: "In a rulerless land, a monk who wanders alone, who has subdued his senses, who mediates himself on the soul and who takes up an abode wherever evening overtakes him, cannot roam around the city."

glosses.meaning: and who takes up an abode wherever evening overtakes him

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जन पदे योग क्षेमम् प्रवर्तते |
न च अपि अराजके सेना शत्रून् विषहते युधि
verses.iast:
na arājake jana pade yoga kṣemam pravartate |
na ca api arājake senā śatrūn viṣahate yudhi
verses.translation: "In a rulerless land; gain and security are not duly established. In anarchy, army cannot conquer enemies in battle."

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जनपदे हृष्टैः परमवाजिभिः |
नराः सम्यान्ति सहसा रथैश्च परिमण्डिताः
verses.iast:
na arājake janapade hṛṣṭaiḥ paramavājibhiḥ |
narāḥ samyānti sahasā rathaiśca parimaṇḍitāḥ
verses.translation: "In a rulerless land, people beautifully adorned, cannot go fast cheerfully in excellent horses and chariots."

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जनपदे नराः शास्त्रविशारदाः |
सम्पदन्तोऽवतिष्ठन्ते वनेषूपवनेषु च
verses.iast:
na arājake janapade narāḥ śāstraviśāradāḥ |
sampadanto'vatiṣṭhante vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca
verses.translation: "In a rulerless land, persons skilled in sacred treatises cannot sit speaking together in forests and groves."

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जनपदे माल्यमोदकदक्षिणाः |
देवताभ्यर्चनार्थय कल्प्यन्ते नियतैर्जनैः
verses.iast:
na arājake janapade mālyamodakadakśiṇāḥ |
devatābhyarcanārthaya kalpyante niyatairjanaiḥ
verses.translation: "In a rulerless land, floral garlands, sweet-meats and gifts for the sake of offering to the deities, are not arranged by the appointed persons."

glosses.meaning: for the purpose of worshipping deities

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जनपदे चन्दनागुरुरूषिताः |
राजपुत्रा विराजन्ते वसन्त इव शाखिनः
verses.iast:
na arājake janapade candanāgururūṣitāḥ |
rājaputrā virājante vasanta iva śākhinaḥ
verses.translation: "In a rulerless land, royal princes smeared with paste of sandal and aloe-wood do not figure brilliantly like trees in a spring time."

glosses.meaning: smeared with paste of sandal and aloe wood

verses.devanagari:
यथा हि अनुदका नद्यो यथा वा अपि अतृणम् वनम् |
अगोपाला यथा गावः तथा राष्ट्रम् अराजकम्
verses.iast:
yathā hi anudakā nadyo yathā vā api atṛṇam vanam |
agopālā yathā gāvaḥ tathā rāṣṭram arājakam
verses.translation: "A rulerless country is like the water less rivers, like the lawn less garden and like the cowherd less cows."

verses.devanagari:
ध्वजो रथस्य प्रज्ञानम् धूमो ज्ञानम् विभावसोः |
तेषाम् यो नो ध्वजो राज स देवत्वमितो गतः
verses.iast:
dhvajo rathasya prajJṇānam dhūmo jJṇānam vibhāvasoḥ |
teṣām yo no dhvajo rāja sa devatvamito gataḥ
verses.translation: "A flag is an identity for a chariot. A smoke is an identity for a fire. King Dasaratha, like a flag, was an identity for us and he has left the world for a heavenly abode."

verses.devanagari:
न अराजके जन पदे स्वकम् भवति कस्यचित् |
मत्स्याइव नरा नित्यम् भक्षयन्ति परस्परम्
verses.iast:
na arājake jana pade svakam bhavati kasyacit |
matsyāiva narā nityam bhakṣayanti parasparam
verses.translation: "In a rulerless land, there is no one's own property for any one. Like fishes, persons always eat away each other."

verses.devanagari:
येहि सम्भिन्न मर्यादा नास्तिकाः चिन्न संशयाः |
ते अपि भावाय कल्पन्ते राज दण्ड निपीडिताः
verses.iast:
yehi sambhinna maryādā nāstikāḥ cinna saṃśayāḥ |
te api bhāvāya kalpante rāja daṇḍa nipīḍitāḥ
verses.translation: "The atheists, who were separated from their right path and who had been tormented; with punishment earlier by the king, are now without fear and are able to exercise their old temperament (due to anarchy)"

glosses.meaning: who were separated from the right path
and now their fear being dispelled

verses.devanagari:
यथा दृष्टिः शरीरस्य नित्यमेवप्रवर्तते |
तथा नरेन्द्रो राष्ट्रस्य प्रभवः सत्यधर्मयोः
verses.iast:
yathā dṛṣṭiḥ śarīrasya nityamevapravartate |
tathā narendro rāṣṭrasya prabhavaḥ satyadharmayoḥ
verses.translation: "As the eye sight is helpful regularly for a proper setting -in-motion of the body, so also a king is the cause of existence for truth and righteousness of a country."

glosses.meaning: for the proper setting in motion

verses.devanagari:
राजा सत्यम् च धर्मश्च राजा कुलवताम् कुलम् |
राजा माता पिता चैव राजा हितकरो नृणाम्
verses.iast:
rājā satyam ca dharmaśca rājā kulavatām kulam |
rājā mātā pitā caiva rājā hitakaro nṛṇām
verses.translation: "The king is truthfulness and righteousness personified in him. In a race, he belongs to a noble family. The king is a mother and a father. The king is a benefactor to people."

verses.devanagari:
यमो वैश्रवणः शक्रो वरुणश्च महाबलः |
विशेष्यन्ते नरेन्द्रेण वृत्तेन महाता ततः
verses.iast:
yamo vaiśravaṇaḥ śakro varuṇaśca mahābalaḥ |
viśeṣyante narendreṇa vṛttena mahātā tataḥ
verses.translation: "Hence, Yama (the god of Death); Kubera (the god of riches), Indra (the ruler of celestials) and the very mighty Varuna (the Lord of Waters) are outstretched by the a high and eminent conduct."

verses.devanagari:
अहो तमैव इदम् स्यान् न प्रज्ञायेत किंचन |
राजा चेन् न भवेन् लोके विभजन् साध्व् असाधुनी
verses.iast:
aho tamaiva idam syān na praGYāyeta kiṃcana |
rājā cen na bhaven loke vibhajan sādhv asādhunī
verses.translation: "Alas! If a king is not there in the world, with his power of discrimination between good and evil, this world will be dark and nothing will be clearly perceived."

glosses.meaning: Alas! raajaana bhavedyati = If a king is not there

verses.devanagari:
जीवति अपि महा राजे तव एव वचनम् वयम् |
न अतिक्रमामहे सर्वे वेलाम् प्राप्य इव सागरः
verses.iast:
jīvati api mahā rāje tava eva vacanam vayam |
na atikramāmahe sarve velām prāpya iva sāgaraḥ
verses.translation: "Even when the emperor was alive, we all of us did not transgress your words, only any more than an ocean transgresses its coast."

glosses.meaning: even when the emperor was alive

verses.devanagari:
स नः समीक्ष्य द्विज वर्य वृत्तम् |
नृपम् विना राज्यम् अरण्य भूतम् |
कुमारम् इक्ष्वाकु सुतम् वदान्यम् |
त्वम् एव राजानम् इह अभिषिन्चय
verses.iast:
sa naḥ samīkṣya dvija varya vṛttam |
nṛpam vinā rājyam araṇya bhūtam |
kumāram ikṣvāku sutam vadānyam |
tvam eva rājānam iha abhiṣincaya
verses.translation: "O, the excellent Brahmana! After renewing the circumstances here and seeing that the kingdom is becoming a jungle without a king, you yourself anoint a youth born in Ikshvaku race or anyone here as a king."
